name: GeoSpatial Agent
description: A2A image geospatial analysis agent that infers likely photo location using the existing DeepSearch-Geo Gemini-default pipeline and describes visible public-safety incidents such as flood, tornado damage, fire, armed threat, or infrastructure damage.

skills.name: Analyze And Localize Image
skills.description: Infer likely location from a photo and describe visible public-safety or disaster context. Accepts an image file, file URI, local image path, or JSON image_path.
examples: Analyze this photo and infer where it was taken.
Describe what happened in this image and localize it.
Analyze this flood image and summarize the visible public-safety context.

skills.name: Infer Photo Location
skills.description: Run the existing DeepSearch-Geo location inference pipeline and return coordinates, precision, confidence, rationale, and hypothesis chain.

skills.name: Assess Visible Incident
skills.description: Describe visible public-safety context in a photo and classify likely incident types such as flood, tornado/severe storm, fire, active shooter/armed threat, chemical hazard, crash, or infrastructure damage.
examples: What appears to be happening in this photo?
Does this image show flood, tornado damage, fire, or an armed threat?
